notes:
{掃除|そうじ} refers to cleaning a space by sweeping, wiping, vacuuming, or tidying up. It covers general cleaning rather than specialized tasks like laundry or dishwashing.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掃除|そうじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {掃除|そうじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / {掃除|そうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clean
- ⟦{掃除機|そうじき}→掃除機：04967_soujiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to vacuum
- {掃除|そうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|い}き{届|とど}いている→行き届く：30420_ikitodoku⟧: well-maintained, kept clean

TYPES OF CLEANING:
- ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧: major year-end cleaning (a Japanese tradition before the New Year)
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掃除|そうじ}: room cleaning
- ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧{掃除|そうじ}: toilet cleaning
- {掃除|そうじ}⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧: cleaning duty (common in schools and workplaces)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese schools, students clean their own classrooms and common areas daily ({掃除|そうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧). ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧ in late December is a widespread tradition of thoroughly cleaning the home before the New Year.
